events.event: Projo chair Budi Arie said VP Gibran handed a resignation letter to President Prabowo at Halim Perdanakusuma air base after Prabowo returned from Aceh; MPR Chairman Ahmad Muzani said he had not received any letter, and the Istana had not confirmed the letter itself.
events.key_numbers: Letter reportedly handed 11 Nov 2026 (Wed) · Istana earlier confirmed only the intent to resign (10 Nov, 2.5-hour meeting) · MPR: no letter received
events.why_it_matters: Whether the Vice President's post becomes vacant depends on which formal route (resignation or HMP) is completed first.
events.spreading_evidence: detik front page 6+ Gibran headlines on 11 Nov; CNN Indonesia nasional top items

events.event: PDIP faction chair Utut Adianto said all 110 PDIP members back the HMP on Gibran; Pontianak Post and Suara.com report the proposal carries 120 signatures and meets the minimum of 25 members from more than one faction, citing UUD 1945 Pasal 7A/7B and UU MD3 Pasal 79(4).
events.key_numbers: 120 signatures from 8 factions · minimum 25 members · PDIP 110 members (102 attended the faction plenary, 8 excused) · plenary expected Thu 12 Nov
events.why_it_matters: Shows how the DPR impeachment route works and how many factions are behind it; an HMP is not yet an impeachment.
events.spreading_evidence: detik front page, CNN Indonesia, Tempo 'Adu Kuat Memakzulkan Gibran'

events.event: Coordinating Minister Yusril Ihza Mahendra said the MK and MA rulings are final with no PK possible and Kemendikdasmen will not file one; Gibran said he would 'fight' at PTUN, while Bakom's head said Prabowo would not have advised that, and Denny Indrayana said he would face Gibran there.
events.key_numbers: MA case 742 K/TUN/2026 · 2.5-hour Prabowo-Gibran meeting on 10 Nov
events.why_it_matters: Explains why the legal route (PTUN) looks closed or contested and why resignation or HMP are the live paths.

events.event: Komisi III DPR is scheduled to hold a meeting with the Kapolri on 12 Nov to discuss the wiretapping case against President Prabowo.
events.why_it_matters: First public DPR questioning of Polri leadership on the case involving the ex-Kapolri.

events.event: Polri spokesperson Irjen Johnny Eddizon Isir said Listyo Sigit Prabowo, Irjen Eko Hadi Santoso and Irjen Slamet Uliandi will face a KKEP ethics hearing 'next week' with no special treatment, a panel chosen by Kapolri Suyudi Ario Seto; former Kadivkum Irjen Ahrie Sonta Nasution already received PTDH from a KKEP panel.
events.key_numbers: 3 generals to face ethics hearing · hearing 'pekan depan' (no firm date) · Ahrie Sonta: PTDH (dismissal without honour), 5-member panel chaired by Komjen Rudy Darmoko
events.why_it_matters: Shows the internal police discipline track running parallel to the criminal case; a PTDH precedent already exists.

events.event: KPK examined GRIB Jaya chair Rosario de Marshal (Hercules) in the ATR/BPN bribery case; Hercules said Rp800 million came from Summarecon's legal counsel for travel costs and mediating a land dispute, and that he handed it to KPK.
events.key_numbers: Rp800 juta · about 65 ha land dispute in Bogor (per Hercules) · 8 suspects named by KPK · 14 questions (Suara.com)
events.why_it_matters: Links a well-known mass-organisation figure to the land-permit (HGB) corruption case; the account is Hercules' own, not a KPK finding.
events.spreading_evidence: detik, CNN Indonesia, Suara.com all covered

events.event: Heroes' Day demonstrations in Yogyakarta began at DPRD DIY and spread to the UGM roundabout; Polda DIY says it secured 154 people and seized molotovs and other items, while UGM and Polda DIY, with Ombudsman and Komnas HAM, are checking reports of a mistaken arrest of a UGM student.
events.key_numbers: 154 people secured (as of 07:58, 11 Nov) · 12 firecrackers, 7 bottles of gasoline, molotov bottles seized · 13 participants unreachable per LBH Yogyakarta · Surabaya: 2 arrested for allegedly carrying molotovs
events.why_it_matters: A protest that turned violent, with a dispute over whether police entered campus and arrested students.
events.spreading_evidence: 'All Eyes on UGM' reported viral (Suara.com); CNN Indonesia nasional top items

events.event: Polda Metro Jaya officers visited ex-KPK chair Firli Bahuri at a badminton hall after he missed two summonses in the Syahrul Yasin Limpo extortion case; police denied he was arrested and said he promised to attend the next examination.
events.key_numbers: 2 missed summonses · named suspect 22 Nov 2023 · SPDP returned by Kejati 7 Aug 2025 · no date given for next examination
events.why_it_matters: A case against a former anti-graft chief that has stalled for nearly three years has moved again.

events.event: Prabowo attended NasDem's 15th anniversary, welcomed by Surya Paloh who said NasDem is loyal to the constitution and 'Prabowo must not fail'; Prabowo thanked PDIP, saying it is not a coalition but both defend the state, and joked about checking under the podium for wiretaps.
events.why_it_matters: Signals how parties line up around Prabowo while PDIP backs the Gibran HMP; headline-only, details not opened.

events.event: The government agreed the 2027 subsidised fertiliser allocation at 9.85 million tons, per a detik headline.
events.why_it_matters: Subsidised fertiliser affects farmers' costs; headline only, comparison with 2026 allocation not checked.
